summary: Fusemachines Inc. filed an 8-K on July 8, 2026, reporting receipt of a Nasdaq notification that it has regained compliance with Listing Rule 5450(b)(1)(C), which requires a minimum market value of publicly held shares of $15,000,000. The company had previously been notified of deficiency and has now cured it, allowing its common stock and warrants to continue trading on the Nasdaq Global Market. This is a routine compliance update, not a special situation. No deal terms, board recommendations, or advisor names are present. No further action is required.
